description: Mapa de calles de Sant Martí Sarroca is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by santmartisarroca.cat. Street map of Sant Martí Sarroca is a set of geographical information regarding the situation of the streets and roads of the municipality of Sant Martí Sarroca. The spatial representation of this data is carried out by means of a map, in PDF format, which shows the nomenclature and the layout of the streets. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Street map of Sant Martí Sarroca" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Map, Plano, Street directory, Sant Martí Sarroca, Catalonia, Cataluña. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
